fix.before: Изображение Венеры мужеженщины, означающее, что стоит она над всеобщим порождением вещей, будучи взятою из воздуха; и что у богов нет различия пола, как и у смертных; и изображение Венеры, скорбящей о смерти Адониса, убитого Вепрем, понимаемое как зимнее и холодное время года.

issues.original: & nelli Dei non esser differenza di esso, come nè mortali
issues.current: there is no difference of sex, any more than among mortals
issues.suggested: there is no difference of sex, as there is among mortals

fix.before: Image of Venus male and female, signifying that she is above the universal generation of things, being drawn from the air; and that among the Gods there is no difference of sex, any more than among mortals; and image of Venus grieving for the death of Adonis, killed by the Boar, understood as the wintry and cold season.
fix.after: Image of Venus male and female, signifying that she is above the universal generation of things, being drawn from the air; and that among the Gods there is no difference of sex, as there is among mortals; and image of Venus grieving for the death of Adonis, killed by the Boar, understood as the wintry and cold season.

issues.suggested: будучи понимаемой как воздух («tolta per» = принятая за); EN «being drawn from the air» → «being taken for the air»
